# Nock

> Nock is the voice and overlay agent for Mac and Windows: dictate into apps, get help where you work, and bring your coding agents and teammates together.

Official website: https://heynock.com/
Product facts updated: 2026-10-20

Nock is the desktop product at heynock.com, made by the Nock team and built on V3Code. It is separate from similarly named services.

## Product and setup
- [Features](https://heynock.com/features/): voice, coding agents, Canvas and widgets
- [Download](https://heynock.com/download/): Mac and Windows
- [Official Nock docs](https://docs.v3code.dev/nock/overview): setup and detailed product guides
- [Team](https://heynock.com/features/team/): handoffs between teammates and agents
- [Connections](https://heynock.com/app-store/): connected apps, account sign-in, API keys and Ollama
- [Privacy](https://heynock.com/privacy/): local and cloud data paths

## Plans
- [Pricing](https://heynock.com/pricing/): current plan features, monthly/yearly prices and lifetime terms
- [Machine-readable product facts](https://heynock.com/product.json): USD prices, eligible account options and Own exclusions

Only Nock has a 7-day card-required trial. Other plans, including Own, start paid. Free remains free. Provider account eligibility and limits still apply. Lifetime allocations are not remaining stock; use the live inventory endpoint for a confirmed remaining count.

## Public project
- [Nock on GitHub](https://github.com/HeavenFYouMissed/nock): public product overview, facts and links
- [Nock Social](https://social.heynock.com/): the separate community, with its own login
